quote.text: You complain that there is an undersupply of books where you are. What matters is not how many you have but how good they are. Varied reading gives pleasure; selective reading does real good.
quote.author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Quality matters more than quantity: Just as a few meaningful books enrich the mind, a few thoughtful moments with your children foster lasting values.
    • Varied experiences can bring joy, but selective guidance shapes character. Choose what to share wisely, guiding them toward wisdom and virtue.
  • Leadership
    • Effective leadership is rooted in wisdom, not in the sheer number of ideas at hand. It is better to deeply understand a few core principles than to be overwhelmed by available options.
    • Selective focus allows a leader to steer teams with clarity. By concentrating on the most valuable insights, you ensure that your direction truly benefits those who follow you.
  • Product Management
    • A product’s success isn’t determined by the number of features it offers, but by the quality and impact of those features. Focus on what delivers real benefits to your users.
    • Embrace varied research to inspire innovation, yet exercise selective decision-making to prioritize features that genuinely enhance user experience and drive sustainable growth.
